items.reason: The main problem is persisting the safeParse wrapper instead of its data as the Google credential key. The comment also includes the response-shape mismatch covered by #09.

The leading problem is the missing prisma import in Salesforce, causing build and runtime failures. The comment additionally includes the unconditional refresh and stale connection credentials covered by #13 and #17.
The comment identifies the computed Zod keys becoming literal property names instead of validating arbitrary token fields. It also includes the fabricated refresh token covered by #07.
Zoho Bigin passes the credential id where refreshOAuthTokens expects the user id, sending the wrong calcomUserId to the sync endpoint.
The sync branch returns a raw Response while callers expect provider-specific token objects, breaking their field accesses.

The principal problem is replacing an omitted refresh token with the literal string "refresh_token", overwriting the valid Office365 token. The comment also mentions the error-handling regression covered by #11.
The comment identifies the webhook secret's non-constant-time comparison. It also includes the unhandled malformed-payload errors covered by #02.
